name: Sollux Captor
source:
Sollux Captor, also known by his Trollian handle, twinArmageddons, is one of the trolls. 

He possesses an incredible psychic diversity. He has been seen using telekinesis, using psionic blasts, having visions of the future, hearing the voices of the soon-to-be-dead, and putting bees to sleep. He is also a well-known hacker, having a lot of experience with computer programs and programming. He is self-deprecating and beats himself up about little things, and has a penchant for bifurcation and duality, often splitting things into red and blue.

His associated zodiac sign is Gemini. He is of gold blood caste.

[From [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Sollux_Captor]MSPA Wiki[/url]]
